related_article.title: A method of identifying allographs in undeciphered scripts and its application to the Indus Valley Script

key_observation: The published article claim is real and source-located: it names H-1302, H-1303, and H-1822 as mirrored-writing / ICIT-correction cases after CISI comparison. That upgrades the prior-work lead, not the local sign evidence.
decision: Treat H-1302/H-1303 as correction-risk acquisition priorities. Do not treat the Nature claim, Blogger images, or local lipi rows as source validation for +700-033+, side order, direction, sign value, or translation.
next_required_evidence: CISI/HARP source image panels for all catalog sides of H-1302 and H-1303
object-specific side labels and direction basis for the two local rows on each object
ICIT/Wells/Fuls row or note showing exactly what was corrected and what sign IDs were involved
controlled crosswalk between the article inline glyphs and local numeric lipi signs
caption/source binding for any Blogger object-panel candidates before using them as evidence
interpretation_boundary: Accepts no local sign correction, sign segmentation, side order, physical side function, numerical/metrological value, sign meaning, phonetic value, language identity, or translation.
